opener_episode.why: There is no recent episode, so this is only a historical hook. The show's collectibles-as-assets thesis is the closest to art. Since the podcast is dormant, pitch the Alts.co newsletter or community (Aug 2026 content still publishing) instead of the podcast.

angles.headline: Art as an Alternative Asset: A Dealer's Reality Check
angles.pitch: How a blue-chip dealer who advises HNW buyers sees pricing, sourcing and buying art, as a counterpoint to fractional-platform hype.
angles.builds_on: Show's collectibles and artwork thesis (Collectable episode)

angles.headline: From NFTs to Auctions: Avery's Alt-Market Experiments
angles.pitch: Launching ArtLife Auctions (Hypebeast, 2020) and ArtGrails, the NFT site that sold Michael Cohen's prison badge (Vanity Fair, 2021) and dropped Ozuna art (Rolling Stone).

angles.headline: Building an Artist Like an Asset
angles.pitch: How developing Alec Monopoly into a global brand, and backing Hebru Brantley and Jammie Holmes early, shows how an artist's market gets made.

booking.route: No podcast booking route; the podcast appears dormant. Best documented route is Stefan von Imhof (Co-Founder & CEO) through Alts.co (newsletter/community) or LinkedIn, pitching a newsletter feature or community AMA instead.

format: Remote interview podcast (2020-2023), each episode built on one alt-asset theme. Alts.co is now mainly a newsletter (~200K investors claimed) and a community/deal platform that runs sponsorships.
red_flags: Inactive: no podcast episodes since Sept 2023 (ListenNotes); a search summary also says the show ran 2020-2023. The newsletter sells sponsorships, so an approach may get steered toward paid placement (unverified). Don't confuse it with 'Alt Goes Mainstream', 'ATLalts' or 'All About Alts', which are different shows.
notes: Recommend dropping from the podcast Top 20, or moving to a newsletter/PR target. Prior research had hosts as unverified; they are now confirmed as Horacio Ruiz and Stefan von Imhof.
